q: How do I get a quote?
a: Use the quote form, call us on 010 085 0769 or send us a WhatsApp message. We come back to you with a price within 24 hours.

q: What do you need from me to give a price?
a: Where the cargo is collected from and delivered to, what it is, roughly how heavy or large it is, and when you need it moved. Even a rough idea is enough to start.
We run road freight and cross-border trucking across the SADC region from our base in Midrand, Johannesburg. For the island states in the region we arrange sea and air freight.

q: What size trucks do you have?
a: Trucks from 8 tonnes up to 36-tonne super links, with professional drivers, so the truck matches the load.

q: Can you handle the customs paperwork?
a: Yes. Our customs team handles import and export declarations, tariff classification, duties and SARS compliance so your cargo clears without delays.

q: Can I hire a truck for one trip, or only on a contract?
a: Both. You can hire a truck and driver for a single trip, or arrange daily, weekly or long-term contracts.

q: Where are you and when are you open?
a: We're at 1070 Old Pretoria Road, Halfway House, Midrand, Johannesburg. Monday to Friday 07:00 to 18:00 and Saturday 08:00 to 13:00 (South African time).
